colors.categorical: js/cues.js — pillar → series as the CityMETER catalog binds them: Land 4 diamond, Location 7 hexagon, Living 1 circle; a ring for no highlight; no star. Records (0.1.3, owner 2026-11-16 “เลือกดูทีละชุด”): one set at a time from the dataset bar — its pins larger with their names (HTML), every other record a neutral dot (text.muted on surface.card); a second outline behind a pin with more records of its set at the point; condominium display points dashed; no glyph inside a pin (owner: “icon ใน symbol … ไม่ช่วยเท่าไร”). A neighbourhood opens on its first highlight with records, or on the dataset read with m (0.1.4, owner “เวลาคลิกย่าน ควรจะเห็น venue ที่ highlighted ก่อนมั้ย”); “ทั้งหมด” is the pick f.show=all. A lodging area of the registry's lodging screen (0.2.0, owner “2 และ update เป็นย่านในทะเบียน”) is outlined dotted (round caps), apart from the registry's solid outlines and the compared ones' long dashes; its kind and novelty are words, not a colour

firstAha: the dataset most concentrated in the neighbourhoods of the scope (its share of the located records, numerator and denominator) against the neighbourhoods' share of the area, then the next three; under a dataset, its share and the densest neighbourhood; computed per selection
countingUnit: one grain per dataset (its own unit); counts of two datasets are never added; out of scope (the dataset has no located record in the province) is never 0
noCaveats: exactness through names, numerator and denominator, the peers of every rank, and one provenance line per view
surroundings: 0.4.0, owner 2026-11-25 “พี่ช่วยปรับ web demo ตามที่แนะนำเลยครับ” (handoff/around/): the glance «ในย่านนี้» — four tiles of one dataset each, the five-step meter of «รอบศูนย์นี้» whose filled bars take the LDS count sample of the mid-rank percentile (identical HEX on both themes; every bar outlined, so the level reads without the colour; a starred dataset has no meter) — and «รอบย่านนี้»: one table (inside · within 400 m · within 800 m), the chosen column stressed by weight and an underline, and on the map one line at that distance in text.secondary, long dashes, never a data colour or a fill; the neighbourhood panel compacts its head like Shopping Center (D-5): the dataset heading kept for screen readers, search and filters aside, the back button in the breadcrumb row
venuePins: 0.4.1, owner 2026-11-25 23:01 “ทำตามที่พี่เสนอเลยครับ” (D-11): a shopping centre or market (ds.item venue) is drawn above every other pin of its view (symbol-sort-key +0.5), a point holding records of several datasets reads as a pile (the second outline) and the pointer reads them all, in words and without a total across datasets (INV-01); the all view names the centres beside their pins (HTML labels, as a chosen set's). D-10: the 400/800 m from the outline's edge are named «ขอบเดินถึง» (a straight line, not a walking route), so they are not read as a service area; the service area, 1, 3 and 5 km from the edge for the figures of people, is planned for round 2.
